SAIS '27
USENIX Conference on Secure Agentic-AI Systems
June 7–8, 2027
Santa Clara, CA, USA
Paper submissions due Thursday, February 4, 2027
The USENIX Conference on Secure Agentic-AI Systems (SAIS '27) will take place on June 7–8, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Santa Clara in Santa Clara, CA, USA.
SAIS aims to secure computing systems as they fundamentally shift towards AI-powered autonomy, where models reason, plan, and act. The conference welcomes researchers, practitioners, developers, and users from all over the world to explore cutting-edge ideas and principled approaches to designing, verifying, and deploying secure and privacy-preserving AI agents into real-world systems.
Interested in participating?
Paper submissions are due Thursday, February 4, 2027. View the Preliminary Call for Papers for more information.
